# Type Alias SchemaLike

SchemaLike: z3.ZodType | z4.ZodType | Schema

A schema accepted by ADK APIs, expressed as a Zod v3 type, a Zod v4 type, or a genai `Schema`.

Use `parseWithSchema` to validate a value against one, and `toJsonSchema` to render one as a plain JSON Schema.
